_help: Boss zombies (Skillz). Cadence comes from Difficulty.boss_* (data/difficulty.json). HP = round(normal_round_hp * hp_mult * Difficulty.boss_cfg().hp_mult), where normal_round_hp = main.base_health + main.health_per_round*(round-1). Kill points = points_per_kill * kill_points_mult (halved economy: 50 base). gravemark_reward is an int for the future Gravemark currency (multiply by Difficulty.rare_currency_drop_mult when wired). Echo adds use echo_* and pay no Gravemark. Spawn roster: BossCatalog.pick_roster(round, difficulty_id).

anims._help: Desi clip names (CLIP_REMAP.txt). loop = clips the boss script sets LOOP_LINEAR on (glTF has no loop flag). slam_hit_time = seconds into SlamImpact when the damage/VFX lands (hands bottom out, frame 4).

fx._help: Enrage has no clip: same clips faster (enrage_speed_scale) + the bell crack emission (material bell_material on BellMesh) x enrage_emission_mult.

anims._help: Channel loops (4 s = channel_duration). ChannelHit plays when the shield breaks; blend out 0.15-0.2 s.

fx._help: Cavity glows while channeling and dims when the shield breaks (ChoirHost_Cavity emission x mult). ShieldProxy = shield VFX anchor (rig root, does not follow the pose).

anims._help: DarkSneak loops through the dark phase (1.6 s = ~1.2 cycles). Sidesteps are IN PLACE: code moves the root sidestep_distance over sidestep_time. SidestepL = character LEFT (-X local). spit_recover = seconds the Spit thrust/recoil plays before the sidestep.

fx._help: OmniLight3D made in code on the Lantern socket (glb has no lights). Beam telegraph starts at BeamOrigin, blight spit at SpitMuzzle. Light dims to dark_energy while DarkSneak is active.

roster_rules._help: pick_roster fills Difficulty.boss_count slots. Slot 0 = Bellwether on the first cadence round (and always on Hard / multi-boss). From the second cadence round on Easy/Medium solo, Choir Host and Lantern Stalker alternate as the solo. Slot 1 = Choir Host. Slot 2+ = Lantern Stalker.
